question: A man buys 9 identical articles for a total of ₹16. If he sells each of them for ₹2.4, then his profit percentage will be ______%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 16, total SP = 9 × 2.4 = 21.6

Profit = 21.6 − 16 = 5.6

Profit % = (5.6 / 16) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 35%

**∴ Answer = 35%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Cost Price of 9 articles = 16, Selling Price per article = 2.4

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total SP = 9 × 2.4 = 21.6

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 21.6 − 16 = 5.6

⇒ Profit % = (5.6 / 16) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

Unit Method

Find per unit CP and SP to simplify calculations.

Shortcut Concept

Directly compare total SP and total CP for faster result.
